key_insight: AI agents can make human discussions more responsive and broaden human contributions, despite generating less semantically diverse conversations themselves.
engineering_relevance: The findings may inform AI facilitators for collaborative engineering discussions, but the study does not evaluate materials discovery.
method: Introduced generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions.
Ran agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains.
Compared human-only and hybrid discussions in a pre-registered participant experiment.
evidence_signal: Simulations found more positive, less toxic but less diverse AI conversations; an experiment with 221 participants across nine threads found improved responsiveness, fewer unanswered contributions, and broader human ideas.
watch_item: Persona conditioning narrowed the diversity gap, but increasing underrepresented personas did not necessarily increase overall diversity.
paper_title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?
